lines.zh: 我慢慢游，海草让开一条路。
lines.en: I swim slowly; the seagrass parts for me.

lines.zh: 尾巴一摆，整片草都在晃。
lines.en: One tail stroke sways the whole meadow.
My belly brushes the grass tips, ticklish.

lines.zh: 我沿着草甸边缘走，不踩中间。
lines.en: I keep to the meadow's edge, not the middle.
I am heavy; I must turn early.

lines.zh: 背上的草随水摆，像小岛。
lines.en: The grass on my back sways like an island.

lines.zh: 前面草太矮，我换个方向。
lines.en: The grass ahead is short; I change direction.

lines.zh: 水被我挤开，又慢慢合拢。
lines.en: The water parts around me and closes again.
A school of small fish trails behind me.

lines.zh: 沙地上拖着长长的影子。
lines.en: A long shadow drags across the sand.
From meadow to reef, I move slowly.
I surface to breathe, then sink again.

lines.zh: 这一路都是能吃的东西。
lines.en: This whole route is edible.
I go slowly, yet never lose my way.

lines.zh: 我顶开浮在水面的草，往前推。
lines.en: I push aside the floating weed and move on.

lines.zh: 水底的沙扬起，遮住了我的脚印。
lines.en: Silt rises behind me and hides my trail.
I chew the grass, loudly.

lines.zh: 水从鼻孔喷出来，一小股。
lines.en: A small spout shoots from my nostrils.

lines.zh: 背上这块草，长了好些天。
lines.en: This grass on my back has grown for days.
I roll over to sun my belly.

lines.zh: 这一片草，够我吃一上午。
lines.en: This patch will last me all morning.
I hum once, and the water trembles.
A little fish is nibbling my back.

lines.zh: 海草缠住我的尾，我不动。
lines.en: Seagrass tangles my tail; I stay still.
I drift with my eyes half closed.
The grass is too tall; I tilt up and bite.
The water is warmer than yesterday.
Who flattened this patch of grass?
I burp; the taste of grass is strong.
I eat slowly; the days are long.
You stand in the grass like a post.
You carry an empty bucket—here to milk me?
I raise my eyes to you, slowly.
That bucket must be here for milk.
Do not slip around behind my tail.
Put that blade away, please.
I am much bigger than you, but gentle.
You may touch my back; I do not mind.
You are standing on seagrass; step aside.
Want to ride? My back is too slick.
My hide is thick, and it still hurts.
Who cut my back?
I sink a little to get away.
That blow knocked grass off me.
I am not running; I am only slow.
The wound feels cold in the water.
I let out a low hum.
Not the flipper; I cannot swim.
Blood spreads; the fish gather.
Being this large, I have nowhere to hide.
Tall seagrass! Give me one stalk.

lines.zh: 那丛草又高又嫩，我看见了。
lines.en: That clump is tall and tender; I see it.
Hold up the grass and I will follow.
You may milk me, but let me eat first.
I smell the juice of cut grass.
Do not fob me off with kelp.

lines.zh: 你手里的草，比这里的好。
lines.en: The grass in your hand beats this patch.
I will come over, slowly.
Eat first, milk after; I am in no hurry.
Just place it by my mouth.
You ran into me and bounced right off.

lines.zh: 我这么大，你应该看得见。
lines.en: I am this large; you should have seen me.
Mind the grass on my back.
You bounced off; are you all right?
I turn slowly; my apologies.
Between us we have muddied the water.
I shift over to let you pass.
My flipper is pinned under your boot.
We both hit the reef; I am fine.
Do not push me; I am heavy.

lines.zh: 我绕着她游，一圈又一圈。
lines.en: I circle her slowly, lap after lap.
Two great bodies, and the water rises.
The grass on her back is denser than mine.

lines.zh: 我们并排吃草，吃了很久。
lines.en: We graze side by side for a long while.

lines.zh: 小崽子会跟着她，不会跟我。
lines.en: The calf will follow her, not me.
She understands my humming.
This meadow can feed a family.
Warm water, plenty of grass—perfect timing.
My flipper touches hers.
Take it slow; we are in no rush.
This stalk fell; I will eat it.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块石头，又放下。
lines.en: I pick up a stone and put it down.
Grass bits are caught on my back.
I nudge the bucket you dropped.
This is too hard; I cannot chew it.
I roll the grass into my mouth.
Shiny things do not interest me.
I push it over to your feet.
A bit of kelp floated up; mine.
I do not pick things up; I eat them.
I must reach that tall clump.
A fresh meadow lies ahead.
I have set my eye on the densest patch.

lines.zh: 有东西在草里动，不管它。
lines.en: Something moves in the grass; ignore it.

lines.zh: 那株草长在石缝里，难办。
lines.en: That stalk grows in a crevice; tricky.
I want to go somewhere shallower.
The waves have flattened the grass there.

lines.zh: 今天的目标是一顿饱饭。
lines.en: Today's goal is a full belly.
Upstream the grass is more tender.
I turn slowly and head that way.
I open my mouth toward that clump.
The grass is tough; I bite at a new angle.
I lower my head to reach the roots.

lines.zh: 它长在石头后，我绕过去。
lines.en: It grows behind a rock; I go around.
I approach quietly, making no sound.
One bite is not enough; another follows.
I keep my eyes on it so none steal it.
The current bends it over—perfect.
No need to chase; grass cannot run.
Almost there; I open my mouth.
I sweep with my tail.

lines.zh: 我的身体一撞，它就退了。
lines.en: One shove of my bulk and it backs off.
I rarely strike, but I am heavy.
That was only meant to shoo it away.
A flipper slap throws up spray.
It nips my grass; I butt it away.

lines.zh: 我整个身子的重量压上去。
lines.en: I put the whole weight of my body down.

lines.zh: 别逼我，我脾气不好时也重。
lines.en: Do not push me; even my temper is heavy.
I shove it aside to shield the calf.
When it is done, I go back to grazing.
I swim in from the far end of the meadow.
So much grass here; I am pleased.
I surface for my first breath.
The grass on my back is still wet.
A new place, with faint-tasting water.
I settle and flatten a patch of grass.
Where there is grass, there am I.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转了一圈，看清楚了。
lines.en: I turn once, slowly, and take it in.
It is quiet here; I could stay.
I am hungry; eating comes first.

lines.zh: 水面烫得像锅，我往下沉。
lines.en: The surface is scalding; I sink lower.

lines.zh: 我摔在石头上，全身发闷。
lines.en: I crash onto stone, stunned all over.
Even I, always submerged, can panic.

lines.zh: 一声炸响，我的耳朵嗡了。
lines.en: A blast rings in my ears.
An arrow sticks in my back grass.
That light leaves me dizzy.

lines.zh: 草被吃光了，我饿得发虚。
lines.en: The grass is gone; I am weak with hunger.

lines.zh: 雷劈在水面，我浑身一抖。
lines.en: Lightning hits the surface; I shudder.

lines.zh: 我掉出水面，下面空空的。
lines.en: I fall past the water into nothing.
